description: Exceptional 2 bedroom /2,5 bathrooms apartment, fully renovated with original floors and decorated with style in the very heart of Paris. Walking distance to all attractions, and direct access to all airports & train stations with 8 RER/Metro lines via the brand new exit facing the apartment (Place Margherite de Navarre access opened in July 2017). Internet+TV, washer, separate dryer, two powerful portable air conditioners.The spaceThis 1100 square feet apartment has 3,40m high ceilings (11,16 feet), restored double doors to the living room and bedrooms, it also has its original but restored oak parquet floor. There is a wonderful feeling of space, volume and light, due to its position at the second floor of the building: this floor is indeed the most prestigious one in these haussmanian buildings. Of course there is a lift, and even a lovely balcony (ideal for two), a plus in the warm days.New since August 2026: to ensure greater comfort during summer heatwaves, the apartment is now equipped with two high-performance portable air conditioners.The entrance hall corridor leads off to each room, starting with the double reception room. The kitchen is large with granite worktops and is fully equipped to high quality amenities. Its French 50's vintage dining table can seat six. You will find there some necessary products like coffee, tea, sugar, salt, pepper, olive oil etc at your disposal.The living room has flat TV with 100+ channels and radio, DVD player, wi-fi etc.In case of need, there is a sofa bed in the living room that can be converted into a 160cm wide bed. For privacy, living room and kitchen can be separated by a full length curtain.Both bedrooms are spacious and luminous, but each one has its own style.
